queries.question: What was NVIDIA's revenue, gross margin, operating income, diluted non-GAAP EPS, and GAAP EPS for Q3 FY2025 (period ending October 2024)?
queries.answer: Revenue $35.08B (YoY +93.6%), gross profit $26.16B, gross margin 74.6%, operating income $21.87B (operating margin 62.3%), net income $19.31B. Non-GAAP diluted EPS $0.81 (+19% QoQ, +103% YoY); GAAP diluted EPS $0.78.
queries.notes: Non-GAAP EPS in 8-K press release; GAAP EPS in financials page. Q3 FY2025 = period ending 2024-10-27.

queries.question: What was Meta Platforms' GAAP operating income, operating margin, net income, and diluted EPS for Q4 2024?
queries.answer: Operating income $23.36B, operating margin 48.3% (YoY +42.6%), net income $20.84B, net margin 43.1%, diluted GAAP EPS $8.02 (META does not publish a separate non-GAAP diluted EPS). Revenue $48.38B.
queries.notes: META's 8-K press release only reports GAAP EPS. Period ending 2024-12-31.

queries.question: What were Microsoft's diluted EPS, net income, and net margin for Q3 FY2025 (period ending March 2025)?
queries.answer: Diluted GAAP EPS $3.46, net income $25.82B, net margin 36.9% (YoY +17.7%). Revenue $70.07B, gross margin 68.7%. Microsoft does not separately report a non-GAAP diluted EPS in its press releases.
queries.notes: MSFT Q3 FY2025 = period ending 2025-03-31, filed 2025-04-30.

queries.question: What was Apple's revenue, gross profit, gross margin, and diluted EPS for Q1 FY2024 (holiday quarter ending December 2023)?
queries.answer: Revenue $119.58B (YoY +2.1%), gross profit $54.85B, gross margin 45.9%, operating income $40.37B, net income $33.92B, diluted GAAP EPS $2.18. Apple's largest seasonal quarter.
queries.notes: AAPL Q1 FY2024 = period ending 2023-12-30. Apple does not report a separate non-GAAP diluted EPS.

queries.question: What was NVIDIA's cash position, total assets, total debt, and stockholders equity at the end of Q4 FY2025 (January 2025)?
queries.answer: Cash & ST investments $43.21B, total assets $111.60B, total debt $10.27B, net debt $1.68B, stockholders equity $79.33B. First quarter NVDA total assets exceeded $100B.
queries.notes: Period ending 2025-01-26. NVDA balance sheet is very lightly leveraged — net debt under $2B.

queries.question: What was Alphabet's cash and short-term investments, total debt, and stockholders equity at end of Q4 2024?
queries.answer: Cash & ST investments $95.66B, total debt $25.46B (long-term $22.57B, short-term $2.89B), stockholders equity $325.08B, total assets $450.26B. Alphabet is nearly net cash neutral — one of the strongest balance sheets among the big-tech group.
queries.notes: Period ending 2024-12-31. GOOGL carries minimal debt relative to its cash hoard.

queries.question: What was Meta Platforms' cash and short-term investments, total assets, and stockholders equity at end of Q4 2024?
queries.answer: Cash & ST investments $77.81B, total assets $276.05B, stockholders equity $182.64B, total debt $49.06B. Net debt only $5.17B — META effectively runs near net-cash-neutral despite a $49B debt load.
queries.notes: Period ending 2024-12-31.

queries.question: How much total debt did Apple carry versus stockholders equity at end of Q4 FY2024 (September 2024), and what was net debt?
queries.answer: Total debt $119.06B, stockholders equity only $56.95B, total assets $364.98B, cash $65.17B, net debt $89.12B. Apple deliberately carries ~2x more debt than equity — structured leverage for buybacks, not distress.
queries.notes: Period ending 2024-09-28. AAPL's balance sheet is structurally over-levered by design.

queries.question: What was NVIDIA's operating cash flow, capital expenditures, and free cash flow in Q3 FY2025?
queries.answer: Operating cash flow $17.63B, capex -$0.81B, free cash flow $16.81B (FCF margin ~47.9%). NVDA runs an exceptionally capex-light model — capex is less than 5% of revenue.
queries.notes: Period ending 2024-10-27.

queries.question: What were Microsoft's operating cash flow, capital expenditures, and free cash flow in Q4 FY2024 (June 2024)?
queries.answer: Operating cash flow $37.20B, capex -$13.87B, free cash flow $23.32B. Capex was 21% of revenue, reflecting heavy Azure/AI data center buildout.
queries.notes: Period ending 2024-06-30. FCF declined from prior quarters as capex ramped.

queries.question: What was Meta Platforms' operating cash flow, capex, and free cash flow in Q3 2024?
queries.answer: Operating cash flow $24.72B, capex -$8.26B, free cash flow $16.47B. Meta also repurchased $8.82B of stock in the same quarter.
queries.notes: Period ending 2024-09-30. Verified from _facts cash_flow. Numbers are correct.

queries.question: How much did NVIDIA spend on stock buybacks and what was stock-based compensation in Q3 FY2025?
queries.answer: Stock buybacks -$11.00B, stock-based compensation $1.25B, dividends paid -$0.24B. Buybacks alone were 31% of quarterly revenue — NVDA returned aggressive capital to shareholders.
queries.notes: Period ending 2024-10-27.

queries.question: What was Apple's stock buyback spend and diluted shares outstanding in Q1 FY2024 (holiday quarter ending December 2023)?
queries.answer: Stock buybacks -$20.14B, diluted shares 15.58B, stock-based compensation $3.00B, dividends paid -$3.83B. Total capital returned to shareholders ~$24B in the quarter.
queries.notes: Period ending 2023-12-30. AAPL is the largest single buyback program in history.

queries.question: What was Alphabet's capital expenditure and stock buyback spend in Q4 2024?
queries.answer: Capex -$14.28B, stock buybacks -$15.55B, stock-based compensation $5.81B, free cash flow $24.84B. Alphabet deployed ~$30B in a single quarter between data center capex and buybacks.
queries.notes: Period ending 2024-12-31. Numbers verified from raw _facts cash_flow data.

queries.question: What was NVIDIA's revenue breakdown by business segment in Q3 FY2025 — Data Center, Gaming, Automotive, and Professional Visualization?
queries.answer: Data Center $30.8B (+112% YoY, +17% QoQ), Gaming $3.3B (+15% YoY, +14% QoQ), Automotive $449M (+72% YoY, +30% QoQ), Professional Visualization $486M (+17% YoY, +7% QoQ). Data Center = ~88% of total revenue.
queries.notes: Segment data in the 8-K press release (EX-99.1), not in the FMP financials page. Total revenue $35.08B.

queries.question: What was Microsoft's revenue for each of its three reportable segments in Q3 FY2025, and what was Azure growth?
queries.answer: Intelligent Cloud $26.8B (+21% YoY), Productivity & Business Processes $29.9B (+10% YoY), More Personal Computing $13.4B (+6% YoY). Azure and other cloud services grew 33% YoY (35% in constant currency).
queries.notes: Segment revenue in the 8-K earnings press release. Period ending 2025-03-31.

queries.question: What was Alphabet's Google Services and Google Cloud revenue and operating income in Q4 2024?
queries.answer: Google Services revenue $84.1B (+10% YoY), Google Cloud revenue $12.0B (+30% YoY). Operating income: Google Services $32.836B, Google Cloud $2.093B (Google Cloud operating income doubled YoY from $864M).
queries.notes: Segment data from 8-K press release. Total GOOGL revenue Q4 2024 was $96.47B.

queries.question: What was NVIDIA's year-over-year revenue and operating income growth from Q3 FY2024 (October 2023) to Q3 FY2025 (October 2024)?
queries.answer: Revenue: $18.12B (Q3 FY2024) to $35.08B (Q3 FY2025) = +93.6% YoY. Operating income: $10.42B to $21.87B = +109.9% YoY. Net income: $9.24B to $19.31B = +108.9% YoY.
queries.notes: Requires both Q3 FY2024 and Q3 FY2025 financials pages. YoY growth driven by Data Center AI compute demand.

queries.question: How did Meta Platforms' operating margin and revenue change quarter-over-quarter from Q3 2024 to Q4 2024?
queries.answer: Revenue: $40.59B (Q3 2024) to $48.38B (Q4 2024) = +19.2% QoQ. Operating margin: 42.7% (Q3) to 48.3% (Q4) = +5.6pp QoQ. Net income: $15.69B to $20.84B = +32.8% QoQ.
queries.notes: Requires both Q3 and Q4 2024 pages. Q4 seasonality + ad pricing drives the step-up.

queries.question: How did Microsoft's gross margin and operating margin change quarter-over-quarter from Q4 FY2024 (June 2024) to Q3 FY2025 (March 2025)?
queries.answer: Gross margin: 69.6% (Q4 FY2024) to 68.7% (Q3 FY2025) = -0.9pp QoQ. Operating margin: 43.1% to 45.7% = +2.6pp QoQ. Revenue grew from $64.73B to $70.07B over the same span. Note: this spans three quarters, not one.
queries.notes: QoQ here means Q4 FY2024 vs Q3 FY2025 — three calendar quarters apart, not consecutive.

queries.question: What next-quarter revenue guidance has NVIDIA given across recent earnings calls?
queries.answer: FY2024 Q3 call (Nov 2023): Q4 FY2024 guided to $20.0B ±2%. FY2025 Q1 call (May 2024): Q2 FY2025 guided to $28.0B ±2%.
queries.notes: Guidance numbers appear only in transcript, not in financials pages.

queries.question: What has Jensen Huang said across earnings calls about the revenue opportunity for cloud providers running NVIDIA infrastructure?
queries.answer: On the FY2025 Q1 call (May 2024): "For every $1 spent on NVIDIA AI infrastructure, cloud providers have an opportunity to earn $5 in GPU instant hosting revenue over four years." Same call: "Token generation will drive a multiyear build-out of AI factories."
queries.notes: The $1→$5 cloud revenue multiple is a key Jensen analogy unique to transcript.

queries.question: How has NVIDIA described its China and export-control situation across earnings calls — revenue exposure, expected declines, and the H20 ban impact?
queries.answer: FY2024 Q3 call: China and licensed destinations "consistently approximately 20–25% of Data Center revenue"; sales expected to "decline significantly" in Q4 FY2024. FY2025 Q2 call: China DC revenue grew sequentially in Q2 but "remains below levels seen prior to the imposition of export controls." FY2026 Q1 call (May 2025): H20 ban effective April 9 — $4.6B H20 revenue recognized pre-ban, $4.5B inventory write-down and purchase obligation charge, $2.5B unable to ship. China AI accelerator market estimated to "grow to nearly $50 billion."
queries.notes: Spans three calls. The 20-25% figure and the H20 $4.5B charge are both transcript-only disclosures.

queries.question: How has Meta's annual capex guidance changed across earnings calls as AI infrastructure demand grew?
queries.answer: Q1 2024 call: full year 2024 capex guided to $35B–$40B, raised from the prior range of $30B–$37B, citing accelerating infrastructure investment. Q2 2024 call: raised again to $37B–$40B (from $35B–$40B), driven by Llama 4 needing "almost 10 times more compute" than Llama 3. Q4 2024 call: 2025 full-year capex $60B–$65B, with "almost 1 gigawatt of capacity" coming online in 2025.
queries.notes: Three successive raises: $30-37B → $35-40B → $37-40B → $60-65B for following year.

queries.question: What has Alphabet signaled about its capital expenditure trajectory across earnings calls, and what specific 2025 commitment did it announce?
queries.answer: Q4 2023 call (Jan 2024): Q4 2023 capex was $11B; full-year 2023 was ~$32B; for 2024, "we expect investment in CapEx will be notably larger than in 2023." Q4 2024 call (Feb 2025): 2025 full-year capex ~$75B, with approximately $16B–$18B expected in Q1 2025 alone; broke ground on 11 new cloud regions and data center campuses in 2024; announced 7 new subsea cable projects.
queries.notes: 2023 full-year capex ~$32B verified from quarterly financials. 2025 commitment of $75B is a transcript-only disclosure.

queries.question: What has NVIDIA disclosed across earnings calls about Blackwell production challenges, ramp timeline, and the scale at which hyperscalers are deploying Blackwell?
queries.answer: FY2025 Q2 call (Aug 2024): "We executed a change to the Blackwell GPU mask to improve production yields. Blackwell production ramp is scheduled to begin in the fourth quarter and continue into fiscal year '26. Blackwell demand is well above supply, and we expect this to continue into next year." FY2026 Q1 call (May 2025): Blackwell contributed ~70% of data center compute revenue; Microsoft already deployed "tens of thousands" of Blackwell GPUs, ramping to "hundreds of thousands of GB200s"; major hyperscalers each deploying "nearly 1,000 NBL72 racks, or 72,000 Blackwell GPUs per week."
queries.notes: Mask change for yield is a supply chain disclosure unique to the FY2025 Q2 transcript.

queries.question: What specific named customers and their GPU cluster sizes has Jensen Huang cited across NVIDIA earnings calls?
queries.answer: FY2024 Q3 call: Tesla upgraded to 7,000 A100 GPUs for autopilot training; UK Isambard-AI built with ~5,500 Grace Hopper Superchips; Germany Jülich centre building with ~24,000 Grace Hopper Superchips. FY2025 Q1 call: Tesla expanded training cluster to 35,000 H100 GPUs; Meta trained Llama 3 on a cluster of 24,000 H100 GPUs. FY2026 Q1 call: Microsoft deployed tens of thousands of Blackwell, ramping to hundreds of thousands of GB200s with OpenAI as a key customer.
queries.notes: Cluster sizes grow across calls: 7K A100s → 35K H100s → tens/hundreds of thousands Blackwell.

queries.question: What has Meta said across earnings calls about its MTIA custom AI chip — what workloads it runs, the rollout timeline, and why Meta is building its own silicon?
queries.answer: Q4 2024 call: "In 2024 we started deploying MTIA to our ranking and recommendation inference workloads for ads and organic content. We expect to further ramp adoption of MTIA for these use cases throughout 2025 before extending our custom silicon efforts to training workloads for ranking and recommendations next year." Rationale: "pursuing cost efficiencies by deploying our custom MTIA silicon in areas where we can achieve a lower cost of compute by optimizing the chip to our unique workloads… off-the-shelf silicon isn't necessarily optimal."
queries.notes: MTIA details first disclosed substantively on the Q4 2024 call.

queries.question: What custom silicon chips has Microsoft named across earnings calls, and what data center capacity milestones has it cited?
queries.answer: FY2024 Q3 call (Apr 2024): Microsoft offers "the most diverse selection of AI accelerators, including the latest from NVIDIA, AMD, as well as our own first-party silicon." FY2025 Q2 call (Jan 2025): named four first-party chips — Maia, Cobalt, Boost, and HSM. Capacity milestone: "We have more than doubled our overall data center capacity in the last three years and we have added more capacity last year than any other year in our history."
queries.notes: Maia and Cobalt are the headline names; Boost and HSM are less widely reported but appear in the FY2025 Q2 transcript.

queries.question: How has Google described its TPU technology and named AI customers on Google Cloud across earnings calls?
queries.answer: Q4 2023 call: AI Hypercomputer with TPUs and GPUs; named customers Anthropic, Character AI, Essential AI, and Mistral AI; Vertex AI API requests up ~6x from H1 to H2 2023. Q4 2024 call: Trillium (6th-gen TPU) delivers "4x better training performance and 3x greater inference throughput" vs prior generation; Google Cloud was first to run a customer on the Blackwell platform.
queries.notes: Anthropic, Character AI, Mistral as named TPU customers is a key supplier/customer detail unique to transcript.

queries.question: What has Apple disclosed across earnings calls about its active device count, paid subscriptions, and major product launches?
queries.answer: Q4 FY2024 call (Nov 2023): iPhone revenue $43.8B (September quarter record); Services $22.3B (+16% YoY), all-time record; 1B+ paid subscriptions — "nearly double the number we had only three years ago"; all-time records in India, plus September quarter records in Brazil, Canada, France, Indonesia, and others. Q1 FY2024 call (Feb 2024): 2.2B active devices; 1B+ paid subscriptions — "more than double the number we had only four years ago"; Apple Vision Pro launched the following day (February 2, 2024).
queries.notes: 2.2B active devices and 1B paid subscriptions are transcript-only milestone disclosures.

queries.question: What GPU throughput or performance numbers has NVIDIA cited across earnings calls to illustrate generational improvement?
queries.answer: FY2024 Q3 call: H100 HGX system has "35,000 parts, weighs 70 pounds, contains 8 Hopper chips"; InfiniBand networking "grew fivefold year-on-year." FY2025 Q1 call: a single HGX H200 server delivers "24,000 tokens per second, supporting more than 2,400 users at the same time" running Llama 3 70B parameters.
queries.notes: 35K parts / 70 lbs for H100 and 24K tokens/sec for H200 are vivid spec disclosures unique to transcripts.

queries.question: What has Microsoft disclosed about GitHub Copilot subscriber growth and broader Copilot enterprise adoption across earnings calls?
queries.answer: FY2024 Q3 call (Apr 2024): GitHub Copilot reached 1.8M paid subscribers, growth "accelerating to over 35% quarter-over-quarter"; "nearly 60% of the Fortune 500 now use Copilot"; $1B+ multi-year deals from Cloud Software Group and Coca-Cola announced.
queries.notes: 1.8M Copilot subscribers and 60% Fortune 500 adoption are transcript-only KPIs.

queries.question: What has Meta disclosed across earnings calls about Meta AI's user scale and the impact of AI on its advertising systems?
queries.answer: Q2 2024 call: "More than 50% of the content people see on Instagram is now AI recommended." Q4 2024 call: Meta AI reached 700M monthly actives; Advantage+ shopping surpassed $20B annual run-rate, growing 70% YoY in Q4; Andromeda (built with NVIDIA) enabled "10,000 times increase in the complexity of models used for ads retrieval."
queries.notes: Andromeda and the 10,000x model complexity claim are not in any financial filing — transcript-only.

queries.question: What have companies disclosed across earnings calls about the compute scale required to train their next-generation AI models?
queries.answer: Meta Q2 2024: Llama 4 training will need "almost 10 times more compute" than Llama 3. Meta Q4 2024: Llama 4 mini completed pre-training; planning "almost 1 gigawatt of capacity" for 2025 and a 2GW+ datacenter. NVDA FY2025 Q1: Meta trained Llama 3 on 24,000 H100 GPUs; Tesla runs 35,000 H100s for training.
queries.notes: Cross-company question — multiple transcripts required for a complete answer.

queries.question: What has Alphabet disclosed across earnings calls about its data center buildout, subsea cables, and cloud infrastructure investment scale?
queries.answer: Q4 2023 call: Q4 2023 capex $11B; full-year 2023 ~$32B; 2024 to be "notably larger." Q4 2024 call: 2025 capex ~$75B total; Q1 2025 alone ~$16B–$18B; broke ground on 11 new cloud regions and data center campuses in 2024; announced 7 new subsea cable projects; Google data centers deliver "nearly 4x more computing power per unit of electricity" vs 5 years prior.
queries.notes: The 7 subsea cable projects and 11 cloud region groundbreakings are transcript-only infrastructure disclosures.

queries.question: What has Meta said across earnings calls about the physical scale of its AI infrastructure buildout?
queries.answer: Q2 2024 call: "planning for the compute clusters and data we'll need for the next several years." Q4 2024 call: "We expect to bring online almost 1 gigawatt of capacity this year, and we're building a 2 gigawatt and potentially bigger AI datacenter that is so big that it will cover a significant part of Manhattan if it were placed there." 2025 capex $60B–$65B.
queries.notes: The Manhattan-scale datacenter analogy is a Zuckerberg quote unique to the Q4 2024 call.

queries.question: What has Google management said across earnings calls about the pace of AI workload adoption on Google Cloud — developer counts, compute consumption, and enterprise customers?
queries.answer: Q4 2023 call: Vertex AI API requests up ~6x from H1 to H2 2023; AI Hypercomputer customers include Anthropic, Character AI, Mistral AI, Essential AI. Q4 2024 call: more than 4.4M developers using Gemini models — "double the number from just 6 months ago"; Cloud customers consuming "more than 8x the compute capacity for training and inferencing compared to 18 months ago."
queries.notes: 8x compute consumption and 4.4M Gemini developers are transcript-only adoption signals.

queries.question: What has Microsoft management said across earnings calls about Azure AI capacity, demand versus supply dynamics, and AI's contribution to Azure growth?
queries.answer: FY2024 Q3 call (Apr 2024): Azure AI contributed "7 points of growth" to Azure overall; commercial bookings up 29%; first-party silicon offered alongside NVIDIA and AMD. FY2025 Q2 call (Jan 2025): "doubled overall data center capacity in the last three years"; "added more capacity last year than any other year in our history"; Azure described as "the infrastructure layer for AI."
queries.notes: The 7-point AI contribution to Azure growth is a CFO disclosure unique to transcript.

queries.question: What have the major hyperscalers committed to spending on AI infrastructure, and how have those commitments scaled over successive earnings calls?
queries.answer: Meta: 2024 capex raised to $37B–$40B (Q2 2024 call); 2025 guided to $60B–$65B (Q4 2024 call). Alphabet: full-year 2023 capex ~$32B; 2024 to be "notably larger" (Q4 2023 call); 2025 commitment ~$75B (Q4 2024 call). NVDA (FY2026 Q1 call): hyperscalers each deploying ~72,000 Blackwell GPUs per week on average.
queries.notes: Cross-company aggregation question. Alphabet 2023 full-year capex ~$32B verified from quarterly financials data.

queries.question: What were NVIDIA's full-year FY2025 revenue and Data Center revenue, and what Q1 FY2026 guidance did the company give in its earnings press release?
queries.answer: FY2025 total revenue $130.5B (+114% YoY), Data Center $115.2B (+142% YoY), GAAP EPS $2.94 (+147%). Q1 FY2026 guidance: revenue $43.0B ±2%, GAAP gross margin 70.6% ±50bps.
queries.notes: Q1 FY2026 guidance and FY2025 full-year totals only in the 8-K press release.

queries.question: Which cloud providers were named in NVIDIA's earnings press release as deploying GB200 NVL72 systems?
queries.answer: AWS, CoreWeave, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, and Oracle Cloud were all named as cloud providers bringing GB200 systems to market. Also named: SoftBank (Japan), Foxconn (Taiwan), Denmark sovereign AI — 1,528 H100 GPUs.
queries.notes: Named cloud and sovereign AI partners are 8-K-only disclosures, not in earnings transcripts.

queries.question: What did NVIDIA's earnings press release say about the xAI Colossus cluster and sovereign AI supercomputer deployments?
queries.answer: xAI Colossus: 100,000 NVIDIA Hopper GPUs with Spectrum-X Ethernet. Sovereign AI: Denmark's largest sovereign AI supercomputer with 1,528 H100 GPUs + Quantum-2 InfiniBand; SoftBank building Japan's most powerful AI supercomputer with Blackwell; Foxconn building Taiwan's fastest AI supercomputer with Blackwell.
queries.notes: Named deployment sizes and sovereign AI customers are 8-K press release specifics.

queries.question: What were the growth rates for Microsoft's sub-segments — LinkedIn, Dynamics 365, and Search & news ads — in its Q3 FY2025 earnings press release?
queries.answer: LinkedIn +7% (up 8% constant currency), Dynamics 365 +16% (up 18% CC), Search & news ads excluding TAC +21% (up 23% CC). Microsoft Cloud overall $42.4B (+20%). Azure +33% (up 35% CC). $9.7B returned to shareholders via dividends and buybacks.
queries.notes: Sub-segment growth rates at this granularity appear only in the 8-K press release.

queries.question: What were Meta's full-year 2024 revenue, operating income, free cash flow, and capex from its earnings press release, and what Q1 2025 guidance did it provide?
queries.answer: FY2024: revenue $164.5B (+22%), operating income $69.4B (+48%), operating margin 42% (up 7pp), diluted EPS $23.86 (+60%), free cash flow $52.1B, capex $39.23B. Q1 2025 guidance: revenue $39.5B–$41.8B (8–15% growth). FY2025 capex: $60B–$65B.
queries.notes: Full-year FCF and capex totals are 8-K-only; transcript gives quarterly run-rate.

queries.question: What does Alphabet's FY2024 annual report say about its revenue concentration in advertising, and what AI-related risk factors does it disclose?
queries.answer: "More than 75% of total revenues from online advertising" — risks include ad-blocking, reduced advertiser spending, and cookie deprecation. AI risk: "AI technology and services are highly competitive, rapidly evolving, require significant investment; other companies may develop AI products and technologies that are similar or superior." Infrastructure risk: "industry supply capacity for AI accelerators (GPUs and custom TPUs) is highly competitive and rapidly evolving."
queries.notes: 75% advertising concentration and AI supply chain risk are verbatim 10-K risk factor language.

queries.question: What were Google Services and Google Cloud operating income and margins for full-year FY2024 per the annual report?
queries.answer: Google Services: $121.3B operating income (40% margin). Google Cloud: $6.11B operating income (14% margin). Other Bets: -$4.4B operating loss. Total FY2024 revenue $350.0B. Google Cloud full-year revenue: $43.2B (+31%).
queries.notes: Segment operating margins at this precision are 10-K only — not in transcript or 8-K.

queries.question: When did Microsoft acquire Activision Blizzard and for what terms?
queries.answer: Completed October 13, 2023 for $75.4B. Drove Xbox content & services revenue up 50% YoY, with the acquisition contributing approximately 44 percentage points of that growth. Also contributed to Microsoft Cloud reaching $137.4B (+23% YoY) for FY2024.
queries.notes: Acquisition price and completion date are 10-K disclosures. Revenue attribution to the acquisition is only in the annual MD&A.

queries.question: Which named automotive, healthcare, robotics, and telecom partners appeared in NVIDIA's recent earnings press releases?
queries.answer: Automotive: Toyota (adopting DRIVE AGX Orin), Hyundai Motor Group. Healthcare/genomics: IQVIA, Illumina, Mayo Clinic, Arc Institute. Robotics: 1X, Agile Robots, Waabi, Uber. Telecom: Verizon (private 5G + NVIDIA AI Enterprise). Networking: Cisco (integrating Spectrum-X). Consulting: Accenture, Deloitte, Google Cloud.
queries.notes: Named vertical partners at this specificity only appear in 8-K press releases.

queries.question: What was Apple's geographic revenue breakdown in Q1 FY2025, and which region declined year-over-year?
queries.answer: Americas $52.6B (+4.4%), Europe $33.9B (+11.5%), Greater China $18.5B (-11.1%), Japan $9.0B (+15.8%), Rest of Asia Pacific $10.3B (+1.3%). Greater China was the only region to decline. Total revenue $124.3B — all-time record. Services $26.3B — all-time record.
queries.notes: Geographic revenue at country/region level is 8-K only for Apple.

queries.question: How much money did Meta lose in Reality Labs in FY2024?
queries.answer: $17.73B operating loss in FY2024 (up from $16.12B in FY2023). Q4 2024 alone: -$4.97B. Annual report states verbatim: "In 2024, our RL segment reduced our overall operating profit by approximately $17.73 billion, and we continue to expect our RL operating losses to increase in 2025." RL revenue FY2024: $2.15B. Total RL investment: $19.88B.
queries.notes: Full-year RL loss breakdown is in the 10-K and 8-K — not broken out in the earnings call transcript.

queries.question: What were Meta's geographic revenue growth rates in Q3 2024 per its quarterly filing, and which region grew fastest?
queries.answer: US & Canada +16%, Europe +22%, Asia-Pacific +19%, Rest of World +24%. Rest of World grew fastest. Family of Apps total revenue $40.3B (+19%), advertising $39.9B (+19%). Average price per ad +11% YoY. Ad impressions +7% YoY.
queries.notes: Geographic growth rate breakdown at this granularity is 10-Q only.

queries.question: What is Meta's biggest risk right now?
queries.answer: Per SEC filings: (1) Regulatory — EU Digital Services Act, Digital Markets Act, and GDPR enforcement "could significantly impact our business"; active US regulatory headwinds. (2) Platform dependency — Apple iOS changes "significantly impacting ad targeting capability." (3) Reality Labs drag — $17.73B operating loss in FY2024, losses "expected to increase meaningfully in 2025." (4) Advertising concentration — nearly all revenue from ads, subject to macro and policy shifts.
